Frequency once per day (twice per day at 12th level)

Your stand uses its raw body for something its Stand Ability can't do. Choose one trick. You can't use the same trick twice in the same encounter.

  • Long Reach Your stand stretches: its next Strike this turn has a reach of 15 feet.
  • Steady Hands Your stand attempts one Acrobatics, Athletics or Thievery check, using your stand's attack modifier in place of the skill modifier.
  • Snatch Your stand grabs an unattended object of light Bulk or less within 30 feet of it and brings it to your hand.
  • Brute Force One creature in your stand's reach takes your Stand Ability's at-will damage (@Check[fortitude|against:stand|basic]{basic Fortitude} save against your stand DC). On a failure it's also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{off-guard} until the end of your turn; on a critical failure it's also pushed 10 feet away from your stand.
